sessionStart.powershell: $r = $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT; if (-not $r) { $r = $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not $r) { $r = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not $r) { $r = (Get-Location).Path }; $w = Join-Path (Join-Path $r 'scripts') 'invoke-context-contributor.ps1'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $w -PathType Leaf) { & $w 'ai-attribution@copilot-extensions' 'publication-policy' 'scripts/emit-policy.ps1' '--aggregate' } else { [Console]::Out.Write('{}') }
sessionStart.bash: r="${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PWD}}}"; w="$r/scripts/invoke-context-contributor.sh"; if [ -f "$w" ]; then bash "$w" ai-attribution@copilot-extensions publication-policy scripts/emit-policy.sh --aggregate; else printf '{}'; fi
